meta.title: VMS / VRP Import: refused for a user without the Implementation Partner role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role and as an Implementation Partner on the same Enterprise tenant
Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan
Locate and attempt the VMS / VRP Import action
Compare refusal or absence for the unprivileged user with availability for the Implementation Partner
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Implementation Partner role and as an Implementation Partner on the same Enterprise tenant; Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan; Locate and attempt the VMS / VRP Import action; Compare refusal or absence for the unprivileged user with availability for the Implementation Partner

args.need: On the same Enterprise tenant, sign in first as a user without the Implementation Partner role and then as an Implementation Partner; locate VMS / VRP Import, attempt the import as each user, and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available.
